tokens.name: Pollen Burst
tokens.description: Releases a burst of pollen in a wide radius, instantly collecting from all nearby flowers.
tokens.effect: Collects pollen from up to 12 flowers around the bee at once.

tokens.name: Honey Shield
tokens.description: Coats the bee in a protective layer of hardened honey, absorbing incoming damage.
tokens.effect: Blocks the next 3 hits from enemies. Lasts 12 seconds.

tokens.name: Nectar Trail
tokens.description: Leaves a glowing nectar trail that boosts pollen collection for all bees passing through it.
tokens.effect: +30% pollen collection for bees in trail. Trail lasts 6 seconds.

tokens.name: Swarm Call
tokens.description: Summons a small swarm of helper bees to attack nearby enemies and collect stray pollen.
tokens.effect: Spawns 3 helper bees for 10 seconds. Each collects 5 pollen per second.

tokens.name: Flower Bloom
tokens.description: Forces all flowers in range to bloom simultaneously, dramatically increasing their pollen yield.
tokens.effect: All flowers within 10 tiles bloom instantly and yield 2x pollen for 8 seconds.

tokens.name: Speed Surge
tokens.description: Overcharges the bee's wings for a brief burst of incredible speed.
tokens.effect: +75% movement speed and +50% collection speed for 6 seconds.

tokens.name: Thunder Strike
tokens.description: Calls down a bolt of lightning that electrifies flowers and stuns enemies in the area.
tokens.effect: Deals 25 damage to all enemies in a 7-tile radius and stuns them for 3 seconds. Electrified flowers yield +40% pollen.

tokens.name: Ice Crystal
tokens.description: Fires a shard of ice that freezes everything in its path solid.
tokens.effect: Freezes all enemies in a line for 5 seconds. Frozen flowers yield double pollen when collected.

tokens.name: Ember Aura
tokens.description: Surrounds the bee in a swirling ring of embers that passively scorches nearby enemies and red flowers.
tokens.effect: Burns enemies for 5 damage/s. Red flowers within 5 tiles yield +25% pollen. Lasts 10 seconds.

tokens.name: Wind Gust
tokens.description: Unleashes a powerful gust of wind that sweeps pollen tokens toward the hive automatically.
tokens.effect: All loose pollen tokens within 15 tiles are pulled toward the hive. Lasts 5 seconds.
